page_title: VER 1-1 LEC | Verona v Lecce 11/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' Lameck Banda (Lecce) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
90+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) was quite harsh and Fabio Maresca didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' The free kick from long range, taken by Lecce, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
89' Corner kick. Verona will have an opportunity.
87' One of the players from Verona times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
86' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
85' Lecce control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
82' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
81' Here comes a substitution. Nicolas Valentini is given a rest as he is replaced by Flavius Daniliuc (Verona).
80' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
80' 6:10 – the total goal attempt statistics.

79' Medon Berisha (Lecce) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Lorenzo Montipo makes a decent save to deny his effort directed to the middle of the target.
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Antoine Bernede (Verona) will replace Amin Sarr.
75' Here is a change. Cheikh Niasse is going off and Paolo Zanetti gives the last tactical orders to Dailon Rocha Livramento (Verona).
75' Tiago Gabriel comes onto the pitch after Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
74' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
72' Cheikh Niasse (Verona) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
72' The corner is swung in but Lecce can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

72' Lameck Banda (Lecce) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lecce will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
69' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
68' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
67' Daniel Mosquera (Verona) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
67' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
66' Marco Giampaolo has decided to make a change. Medon Berisha (Lecce) replaces Balthazar Pierret.
65' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) was too forceful with his tackle and Fabio Maresca interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
64' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) tries his luck from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort, but it is well blocked by the defender.
63' Here's the change. Casper Tengstedt leaves the pitch and Daniel Mosquera (Verona) comes on as a substitute.
62' Amin Sarr (Verona) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Fabio Maresca blows his whistle for a foul.
62' Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 9:11.
60' Lameck Banda (Lecce) latched on to an accurate pass deep into the box and attempted to fire the ball past the keeper, but the shot is way off target. What a miskick!
60' Verona are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
58' Ondrej Duda floats a good corner into the box that Diego Coppola (Verona) gets on the end of, but his effort on goal scorches just wide of the right post.
57' Ondrej Duda (Verona) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

57' Amin Sarr (Verona) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. The referee blows his whistle, Verona are awarded a corner kick.
55' Marco Giampaolo prepares a substitution. Tete Morente is replaced by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
55' Substitution. Lameck Banda (Lecce) has come on for Konan Ndri.
55' Konan Ndri (Lecce) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
54' Federico Baschirotto (Lecce) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
53' The resulting set piece from Lecce is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
52' Lecce take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
52' Lecce try to speed play up by taking a quick free kick.
51' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wladimiro Falcone, who smothers the ball.
51' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
50' Suat Serdar (Verona) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.

48' Amin Sarr (Verona) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Wladimiro Falcone shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
48' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
46' Half-time substitution. Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) is replaced by Danilo Veiga.
46' Paolo Zanetti has made a change at the break. Suat Serdar has come on in place of Tomas Suslov (Verona).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' The end of the first half.
45+1' That was a poorly executed free kick from long distance. Tomas Suslov (Verona) was trying to produce a cross into the penalty area, but his effort sailed off the pitch.
45+1' Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the left post.
41' 1 - 1 GOAL! Tomas Suslov curls the free kick into the box. Diego Coppola (Verona) peels off his marker and arrows a brilliant header past Wladimiro Falcone and into the top right corner. 1:1.
38' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
38' Lecce have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
37' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
36' Fabio Maresca blows his whistle after Daniele Ghilardi (Verona) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Lecce are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
35' Wladimiro Falcone leaps to intercept the corner kick from Ondrej Duda (Verona).
35' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
34' Amin Sarr (Verona) and Cheikh Niasse combine well with a quick one-two and their attacking move continues.
33' Lecce are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
31' Ondrej Duda (Verona) has tested the patience of referee Fabio Maresca and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
29' Amin Sarr (Verona) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
28' The referee points to the corner flag and Lecce will take a corner.
28' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Lecce will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
23' 0 - 1 Goal! Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) fires home from very close range after latching on to a pass from Tete Morente. The score is 0:1.

20' A neat pass is well received by Konan Ndri (Lecce), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
16' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Lecce comes to nothing.

16' Tete Morente (Lecce) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a projectile from close range to the bottom right corner, but Lorenzo Montipo makes a nice save. Lecce have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
16' Lecce have a free kick.
15' Tomas Suslov (Verona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Fabio Maresca had an easy-decision to make.
14' Tete Morente (Lecce) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
11' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
9' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is able to continue to play.
8' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
5' Neat passing move from Lecce in order to create new attacking opportunities.
3' Frederic Guilbert (Lecce) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
2' Verona are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
1' Rough tackle by Nikola Krstovic (Lecce). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Lecce will have the kick-off.
Fabio Maresca will referee today's match.
